Item: As devs, we need to setup the development process
As devs, we need to draft the Requirement Specification to enhance our domain awareness.
As devs, we need to draft an initial Architectural Design Diagram
As warehouse manager, I want to model a 1 room warehouse with no obstacles/loading zones
As warehouse manager, I want to add a simple robot in the scenario
As warehouse manager, I want to add 1 movement mission in the scenario
As a warehouse manager, I want to configure a routing policy that minimizes hop count
As a warehouse manager, I want to configure an assignment policy that assigns missions to the nearest robot
As a warehouse manager, I want to run a simulation of a scenario
As warehouse manager, I want to add multiple movement missions in the scenario
As warehouse manager, I want to model obstacles and the traversal cost of the tiles
As warehouse manager, I want to add multiple simple robots in the scenario
As warehouse manager, I want to configure the scenario with a routing policy that minimizes the time needed to complete the route
As a warehouse manager, I want to configure an assignment policy that assigns missions cyclically
As a warehouse manager, I want to configure a collision avoidance policy based on casual waiting
As warehouse manager, I want to model shelves and loading zones
As warehouse manager, I want to add pickup and deposit missions

As a warehouse manager, I want to configure a priority-based wait collision avoidance strategy, so that higher-priority missions or robots take right-of-way while lower-priority robots yield and wait until path conflicts clear
As a warehouse manager, I want to configure an assignment policy that assigns missions to the robot with the lowest workload

As a warehouse manager, I want to configure a collision avoidance strategy based on time remaining until deadline, so that the robot whose mission is closest to expiring is given right-of-way while other robots yield and wait

As a warehouse manager, I want to configure a reroute collision avoidance strategy, so that conflicting robots calculate alternative paths around blocked or occupied zones rather than halting and waiting.
